name: LV & MV Power Distribution — from civil-ready room to staged energization

activities: substation/switchroom slab, blockwork, roof, doors complete
housekeeping plinths/pads and transformer bunds cast
cable trenches, sleeves and floor cutouts formed
switchroom environmental control (HVAC) available
floor flatness for switchboard rolling/alignment
sequence.note: MEP cannot start until the room and its plinths/trenches are handed over; floor flatness governs switchboard section alignment.

activities: rig and set transformers, MV/LV switchgear, MDB/SMDB, generators, UPS onto plinths
anti-vibration mounts and anchor/bolt-down
level and align switchboard sections, join shipping splits
sequence.note: Heavy rigging needs the access/lifting route and clear room; alignment precedes any bus connection.

activities: assemble busbar/busduct between sections and boards
bus-tie and primary/secondary interconnections
neutral earthing / transformer star-point connection
pull MV/LV power cable on completed containment or in trenches
gland and terminate at both ends
phasing, coring and circuit identification
sequence.note: Depends entirely on containment being installed and bonded first.

activities: connect switchgear, transformer body/neutral, generators, DBs to the earth grid
bond enclosures and cable armour
sequence.note: Interfaces the earthing system; must be complete before any energization.

activities: torque/tightness checks
insulation resistance (megger)
contact/ductor resistance on busbar joints and breaker contacts
protection relay settings loaded, CT/VT ratio and polarity
mechanical interlock and breaker rack-in/out checks
HV/VLF hi-pot on MV cables
transformer ratio, winding resistance, vector group, insulation (oil tests if applicable)
protection relay secondary and primary injection
phase rotation/sequence at each board
earth loop impedance
establish upstream/utility back-feed source
staged cascade: energize MV, transformers, then LV boards
verify phase rotation at each downstream board
sequence.note: Never energize without protection settings loaded and earthing tested; downstream loads isolated or ready.

activities: generator load-bank test and AMF/ATS changeover
UPS battery autonomy/discharge test
synchronising and load transfer
protection discrimination/coordination verification
thermographic survey under load

typical_relationships.reason: equipment cannot be rigged, set or aligned without the room, its plinths and clear rigging access
board sections must be levelled and joined before bus links can be made up
power cable must have a complete, earthed route before it can be pulled
cores must be in place before gland/lug termination at each end
energizing an unearthed board is a safety violation

typical_relationships.before: protection relay settings loaded and injection-tested
typical_relationships.reason: a board must never be energized without verified protection

typical_relationships.before: MV cable HV/VLF hi-pot test passed
typical_relationships.reason: insulation integrity must be proven before applying medium voltage
there must be a live source to back-feed the scheme
LV boards are fed through the transformer in the cascade
faulted insulation must be found before applying voltage
switchgear, transformers and UPS reject heat and need room cooling under load

interfaces.requirement: substation/switchroom, housekeeping plinths, transformer bunds, cable trenches and sleeves must be complete and handed over before equipment setting
power cable pulling requires cable tray/ladder installed, bonded and inspected
energization requires the earth grid connected and resistance-tested; transformer neutral earthed
energization requires a permanent utility/upstream HV supply as the back-feed source
switchroom/UPS-room cooling must be operational before sustained energized load
code often requires fire detection live in electrical rooms and shunt-trip interfaces wired before energization
breaker/generator/UPS status, metering and changeover signals are monitored by BMS
motors/drives need their board energized before motor bumps and loop checks

testing_requirements: Insulation resistance (megger) on cables and busbars
Contact/ductor resistance on busbar joints and breaker contacts
HV/VLF hi-pot test on MV cables
Transformer: turns ratio, winding resistance, vector group, insulation, oil analysis (oil-filled)
Protection relay secondary and primary injection; CT/VT ratio and polarity
Earth loop impedance and earth continuity
Functional interlock and trip checks; breaker timing/trip-unit test
Generator load-bank test; AMF/ATS changeover; synchronising
commissioning_dependencies: Approved protection/coordination study with settings loaded
Fire detection live in electrical rooms (code dependent)
Cable schedule and terminations complete and megger'd
Safe isolation, permit-to-work and LOTO regime in place
Downstream loads ready or isolated for staged energization
typical_exceptions: Packaged/skid substations arrive pre-wired and FAT'd, collapsing several setting/interconnection stages
Temporary construction-power generation precedes the permanent scheme
Factory-tested LV boards reduce site protection-testing scope

work_packages.wp: MV switchgear supply, set and test

evidence: Switchgear was set and busbar-connected before the substation room's plinths and cable trenches were signed off, power-cable pulling was sequenced ahead of the tray/ladder being installed and bonded, and energization was booked before the earthing resistance test and protection injection.
